source_text: Legally, no dedicated statute prohibits it, but a 2017 public interest litigation before the Supreme Court argues its unconstitutionality under Articles 14, 15, and 21 for infringing bodily integrity and gender equality; the case was referred to a constitution bench in 2018 and remains unresolved as of 2024.
